description: All policy lives in the shared preset github>Techsecom/renovate-config - schedule, PR limits, grouping, and the rules that hold major updates and terraform providers for Dependency Dashboard approval. Keep this file thin so the policy has one home.
No postUpgradeTasks here: this repo vendors no Helm charts. Only gitops-argocd does, and it needs `helm dependency update` to regenerate the .tgz ArgoCD actually renders.
tfvars are gitignored and hold live credentials. A PR touching one is a bug, not an update - close it and report.
